Willet's internal Creative Generation eval (84.7) beats Whimbrel's (79.6) by more than the 2.0-point variance threshold, and its instruction-following is documented as stronger on multi-part/constraint tracking. The content has no harm-adjacent element, so Whimbrel's main differentiator (harm aversion) is irrelevant here. Net: Willet is the higher-capability choice for a polished promotional post with no offsetting reason to prefer Whimbrel.
